title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: Nasdaq, S&P 500 edge higher as tech stocks regain footing - The Economic Times
text:
Dow Jones Today | US Stock Market Live: Wall Street traded mixed on Tuesday, even as the tech-heavy Nasdaq hit its first intraday record since early June, driven by strong gains in Gemini parent Alphabet, while optimism over potential US-Iran talks supported broader market sentiment.

US stock index futures were little changed on Tuesday after the previous session’s AI-driven rally, as investors awaited potential talks between Washington and Tehran aimed at ending their six-month conflict. At 7:12 a.m. ET, Dow futures rose 111 points, or 0.21%, while S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures edged up 0.03% and 0.05%, respectively.
